name: Pitch Angle in Bounds
hint: Pitch can be evaluated meaningfully from -180 to 180 degrees, describing the robot’s forward or backward tilt.
instruction: Use comparison limits between -180 and 180 degrees and validate readings that fall outside the interval.

examples.label: Example
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@codeyB pitch angle° :: sensing) > (30)> then
say [Tilted forward]
end
